parameters.name: repeat_penalty
parameters.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

parameters.name: presence_penalty
parameters.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

parameters.name: frequency_penalty
parameters.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum tokens the verifier may generate for one block.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

parameters.name: cache_prompt
parameters.description: Cache the prompt (image embeddings, system message) between blocks.
